mapper.select: select plant_cd, plant_nm from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, plant_cd

select n.node_id, n.node_type, n.node_cd, n.node_nm, wms_node_path(n.node_id) as path from mst_equip_hier n where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.node_type in ('LINE', 'CELL') and n.use_yn = 'Y' order by path
select exists (select 1 from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd})
mapper.sql: (a.node_id is not null) as attr_set, coalesce(a.loc_usage, 'STORAGE') as loc_usage, coalesce(a.stock_yn, 'Y') as stock_yn, coalesce(a.pick_seq, 0) as pick_seq, coalesce(a.mix_item_yn, 'Y') as mix_item_yn, coalesce(a.mix_lot_yn, 'Y') as mix_lot_yn, a.default_status, a.feed_node_id, a.remark, a.row_ver, a.updated_at, a.updated_by

with recursive t as ( select n.node_id, (n.plant_cd || '/' || n.node_cd)::text as path, array[lpad(n.sort_no::text, 9, '0') || rpad(n.node_cd, 30)] as ord, case when n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') then 1 else 0 end as wlvl from mst_equip_hier n where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.parent_id is null and n.use_yn = 'Y' union all select n.node_id, t.path || '/' || n.node_cd, t.ord || (lpad(n.sort_no::text, 9, '0') || rpad(n.node_cd, 30)), t.wlvl + case when n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') then 1 else 0 end from t join mst_equip_hier n on n.parent_id = t.node_id where cardinality(t.ord) < 20 and n.use_yn = 'Y' )
mapper.select:
select n.node_id, n.plant_cd, n.parent_id, n.node_type, n.node_cd, n.node_nm, n.use_yn, t.wlvl as lvl, t.path, (select count(*) from mst_equip_hier c where c.parent_id = n.node_id) as child_cnt,
from t join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = t.node_id left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') order by t.ord
mapper.sql: n.node_id, n.plant_cd, n.node_type, n.node_cd, n.node_nm, n.use_yn, (with recursive up as ( select u.node_id, u.parent_id, u.node_cd::text as path, 1 as d from mst_equip_hier u where u.node_id = n.node_id union all select p.node_id, p.parent_id, p.node_cd || '/' || up.path, up.d + 1 from up join mst_equip_hier p on p.node_id = up.parent_id where up.d < 20) select n.plant_cd || '/' || path from up where parent_id is null) as path, (a.node_id is not null) as attr_set, coalesce(a.loc_usage, 'STORAGE') as loc_usage, a.row_ver
mapper.select: select item_id, item_cd, item_nm, use_yn from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}

with recursive d as ( select n.node_id, array[lpad(n.sort_no::text, 9, '0') || rpad(n.node_cd, 30)] as ord from mst_equip_hier n where n.parent_id = #{nodeId} union all select n.node_id, d.ord || (lpad(n.sort_no::text, 9, '0') || rpad(n.node_cd, 30)) from d join mst_equip_hier n on n.parent_id = d.node_id where cardinality(d.ord) < 20 ) select n.node_id, n.plant_cd, n.node_type, n.node_cd, n.node_nm, n.use_yn, (a.node_id is not null) as attr_set, coalesce(a.loc_usage, 'STORAGE') as loc_usage, a.row_ver from d join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = d.node_id left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') order by d.ord
mapper.insert: insert into wms_loc_attr (node_id, comp_cd, loc_usage, stock_yn, pick_seq, mix_item_yn, mix_lot_yn, default_status, feed_node_id, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (#{nodeId}, hb_current_comp(), #{f.locUsage}, #{f.stockYn}, #{f.pickSeq}, #{f.mixItemYn}, #{f.mixLotYn}, #{f.defaultStatus}, #{f.feedNodeId}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by})

insert into wms_loc_attr (node_id, comp_cd, loc_usage, mix_item_yn, mix_lot_yn, default_status, created_by, updated_by) values (#{nodeId}, hb_current_comp(), #{f.locUsage}, #{f.mixItemYn}, #{f.mixLotYn}, #{f.defaultStatus}, #{by}, #{by}) on conflict (node_id) do update set loc_usage = excluded.loc_usage, mix_item_yn = excluded.mix_item_yn, mix_lot_yn = excluded.mix_lot_yn, default_status = excluded.default_status, -- 보급 라인은 하위에 퍼뜨리지 않는다. 용도가 LINESIDE 가 아니게 되면 비운다(ck_wms_loc_attr_feed) feed_node_id = case when excluded.loc_usage = 'LINESIDE' then wms_loc_attr.feed_node_id end, row_ver = wms_loc_attr.row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = excluded.updated_by where (wms_loc_attr.loc_usage, wms_loc_attr.mix_item_yn, wms_loc_attr.mix_lot_yn, wms_loc_attr.default_status) is distinct from (excluded.loc_usage, excluded.mix_item_yn, excluded.mix_lot_yn, excluded.default_status)

insert into wms_loc_attr (node_id, comp_cd, pick_seq, created_by, updated_by) values (#{nodeId}, hb_current_comp(), #{seq}, #{by}, #{by}) on conflict (node_id) do update set pick_seq = excluded.pick_seq, row_ver = wms_loc_attr.row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = excluded.updated_by where wms_loc_attr.pick_seq <> excluded.pick_seq
